original_card.question: Can one selected pricing or assembly claim be checked by a genuinely independent exact implementation?
methods: Reconstruct the rank ledger from original operations rather than trusting its aggregate.
Implement certified moment inequalities through a different exact enclosure method.

original_card.first_experiment: Recompute one small part of the ledger or one certified enclosure using an independent implementation.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Independent pricing prevents unsupported frontier claims and can reveal genuine accounting slack.
allowed_variations: Reconstruct either a source ledger or a numeric enclosure with a different method.
scope_change_triggers: Importing the primary function and calling its output independent verification.

actual_scope: Independent exact recheck of the two recorded moment acceptances (complex m=73 W=14336 no surcharge; bit m=64 W=28416 with the bad-residue surcharge) at their certified endpoints and next 1e-24 grid points, plus a proved and certified a < D/E diagnostic ceiling for each ledger, with code-disjoint square-root-bisection and exp-inversion log enclosures.
scope_change_reason: The card's question and method are unchanged; refinement names the two ledgers, endpoints and widths. The endpoint-moment card is already covered for the selected record by three code-disjoint series engines (Mercator, base-two, atanh prime chain), so this session does not add a fourth series engine: the new content is the proof and application of the a < D/E diagnostic stated in autoresearch.md section 2, and the bit ledger, which the complex local-word packing ceiling of https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1240 does not cover.
bottleneck_link: The priced moment is the acceptance test for any supplier change; the a < D/E diagnostic is the repository's own fast screen for it. Proving the screen valid (a* < D_eff/E_eff strictly, surcharge included) and measuring its slack (0.30% complex, 0.29% bit at the current ledgers) tells improvers when the screen is decisive and when the exact moment is required. The screening extremum shows the screen alone cannot decide the 1/99 planning target, redirecting effort to coverage/realizability arguments.
stop_rule: Stop after one priced endpoint pair per ledger and one diagnostic; kill any route needing a word rebuild from original operations (out of this session's budget; handed off). One bounded pivot only: from moment re-verification to the D/E lemma after the moment coverage saturation was confirmed.
evidence: research/selected-suppliers-de-diagnostic/RESULT.json from verify.py: PASS_INDEPENDENT_DE_DIAGNOSTIC; moment residuals match the recorded mercator/base_two intervals and INDEPENDENT1094's moment_minus_one digits; certified D/E ceilings 0.0016805907097543 (complex) and 0.0017385572484014 (bit); 12 positive/negative controls including the exactly solvable single-rank root a*=1<1/ln2.
